en: Colorized vintage riverside view showing the town of Riesa on the Elbe River. In the foreground is a grassy and pebbled riverbank with an anchor lying on the ground. Across the water sits a long paddle steamer named "PILLNITZ" with smoke stacks and cabins. Behind the ship is a row of multi‑story town buildings with red and gray roofs, small warehouses, and a church spire rising in the distance. The caption in German is printed at the top left.
